description: I am a girl who, starting at the age of 3, began developing my literary skills. I have written several books, but I want to highlight a special one published, titled "AN ADVENTURE IN THE PLANETS" because in it I express my interest in learning about the universe and everything related to it. In reality, I have clear goals and a strong desire to help humanity from my field of action. Therefore, I want to put my knowledge, creativity and vision into the challenge I close to carry out my project.
summary: It is a digital book containing content relevant to humanity. It addresses the challenge through a story. It is significant because, by means of it, children can easily learn real, scientific facts.
details:
The project consists of a digital a book, created creatively and containing content of significance to both science and humanity, which can be accessed via an included public link.

It addresses the challenge by telling the story of two rovers sent to Mars: Spirit and Opportunity.

Its advantages include easy accessibility -thanks to its digital format and the use of a public link- as well as the fact that it is based on real data and written in languaje that is easily understood by its target audience. The project could be further enhanced with more advanced editing tools and additional development time.

Its impact lies in the idea that there is no better way to travel than through a book; this can inspire children to consider the importance of research, learning, and pursuing their dreams.

A digital book-creation plataform was used to develop the project. It is considered creative because it aims to capture children´s interest by incorporating both striking imagery and real photographs.

The development process took into account the available time and tools to successfully meet the proposed challenge.
dataRefs: Mars Exploration Rovers: Spirit and Opportunity
